tiles.label: Windows memory
tiles.evidence: The 1.5 GiB GPU upload run reached the Windows memory reserve about 35 seconds after movement began. The 2 GiB run reached the reserve during scene loading.
tiles.doneWhen: Load the checkpoint and move through the mission while staying above the existing Windows memory reserve.

checks.label: Scene loading with 2 GiB GPU upload

tiles.label: Asset streaming
tiles.evidence: DirectStorage opened files and the first room rendered. Streaming across room transitions still needs verification.
tiles.doneWhen: Load newly visited areas with their required assets while keeping texture uploads and staging within budget.

tiles.label: Sustained gameplay
tiles.evidence: The opening room rendered after movement. Both GPU upload trials reached the Windows memory reserve and recorded zero display-driver resets.
tiles.doneWhen: Repeat a moving gameplay run through successive checkpoints without a crash, driver reset, or memory stop.

tiles.label: Frame rate
tiles.evidence: The RTX 5060 Ti measured 5.15 FPS and 194.36 ms per frame in a stationary 60-second sample. Submission preparation and GPU work each averaged about 80 ms in diagnostics from that window.
tiles.doneWhen: Reduce submission, GPU, and copy-back time, then meet the published FPS target during sustained movement on the RTX 5060 Ti. Report mean, median, and 95th-percentile frame times.

tiles.label: Missing pipelines
tiles.evidence: In the 5.15 FPS stationary benchmark, diagnostics reported around 270 skips per frame under missing host pipelines. About 266 were suppressed ray-tracing builder stages, about four followed D3D12 rejections of translated compute pipelines with 0x80070057, and about one came from a shader whose lane-mask exchange failed to translate when some lanes were inactive. These are rounded per-frame averages.
tiles.doneWhen: Resolve host refusals and shader translation failures for mission pipelines. Verify the required draws and dispatches during movement.

checks.label: Create pipelines to render the first room
Fix the reported compute translation failure
Verify required direct and indirect draws during movement

tiles.label: RTX 5060 Ti
tiles.evidence: The RTX 5060 Ti rendered the opening room and passed the GPU upload readback check.
tiles.doneWhen: Confirm the physical RTX adapter is doing the rendering and display the opening room.

tiles.label: RT builder
tiles.evidence: The ray-tracing builder is gated when its host pipelines are unavailable. Its suppressed stages account for most of the stationary pipeline skips.
tiles.doneWhen: Create the required builder pipelines and validate that the resulting acceleration structures support the mission's trace passes.

tiles.label: Textures and depth
tiles.evidence: Opening-room geometry is visible. Visual glitches remain.
tiles.doneWhen: Check texture placement, depth, and final composition while changing camera views and moving between rooms.

tiles.label: Lighting and shadows
tiles.evidence: The ray-tracing path has partial builder and shader translation. End-to-end lighting is still unverified.
tiles.doneWhen: Verify that the mission's lighting and shadows render correctly as the camera and scene change.

tiles.label: Boot and menu
tiles.evidence: An offline Windows run reached the main menu using the Series S profile.
tiles.doneWhen: Launch the title and reach its main menu offline.

tiles.label: Opening checkpoint
tiles.evidence: The offline Series S profile loaded the prison checkpoint and rendered its 3D scene.
tiles.doneWhen: Load the opening checkpoint and see the room.

tiles.label: First movement
tiles.evidence: Three scripted keyboard inputs moved the character away from the barred window and into the room.
tiles.doneWhen: Observe the character respond to movement and the scene continue rendering.

tiles.label: Complete the mission
tiles.evidence: The memory reserve stopped the test after the first movement sequence.
tiles.doneWhen: Play from the opening checkpoint through the mission and reach the following checkpoint.

tiles.label: Keyboard and mouse
tiles.evidence: Scripted keyboard movement works. The GameInput mouse path still lacks an implementation.
tiles.doneWhen: Verify movement, camera and aim, interactions, and menu navigation with a physical keyboard and mouse.

tiles.label: DualSense
tiles.evidence: The Windows path reads XInput. A physical PS5 controller has yet to be verified with Loam.
tiles.doneWhen: Use a connected DualSense to walk, look, interact, and navigate menus, and record the Windows input path used.

tiles.label: Game audio
tiles.evidence: Loam has XMA decode and WASAPI output paths. In-game dialogue, effects, and music have yet to be verified.
tiles.doneWhen: Hear distinct dialogue, effects, and music during the mission and through scene transitions.

tiles.label: Save and resume
tiles.evidence: Local XGameSave persistence passes synthetic tests. A checkpoint created by the title has yet to be verified across restarts.
tiles.doneWhen: Create a checkpoint in-game, exit, relaunch, and resume from that checkpoint.

tiles.label: VOP3
tiles.evidence: Synthetic VOP3 fixtures cover byte averaging on RTX and WARP, floating-point median, and 64-bit compare encodings. The mission's remaining translation failures still need attribution.
tiles.doneWhen: Identify any mission VOP3 cases that fail translation and verify their live DXIL outputs, including operand modifiers and alias encodings.

checks.label: Check VOP3 forms implicated by mission diagnostics

tiles.label: Wave64 on RTX
tiles.evidence: Loam implements several wave64 translation paths. The ray-tracing notes record host refusals where shaders still require 64 lanes.
tiles.doneWhen: Preserve cross-lane results for the mission's wave64 shaders on the RTX adapter and confirm their host pipelines can run.

tiles.label: SMEM
tiles.evidence: Synthetic scalar-buffer load checks cover x4, x8, and x16 loads. The required title-level scalar memory paths still need verification.
tiles.doneWhen: Validate the scalar loads used by mission shaders, including dynamic offsets, descriptor tracing, and bounds.

checks.label: Scalar buffer load x4, x8, and x16 fixtures
Mission scalar reads with dynamic offsets
Mission scalar read results and bounds
Track descriptors used by mission scalar reads

tiles.label: Shader address residency
tiles.evidence: The shader address translation path looks up host copies by page. The ray-tracing notes document zero reads and dropped stores when a needed page is absent.
tiles.doneWhen: Provide all pages reached by mission shaders and verify loads and stores across address windows.
